newsitem.title: USA: Giant Food Q4 same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Giant Food Q4 same-store sales fall.

text.p: Giant Food Inc said Tuesday its fourth quarter same-store sales fell 6.8 percent.
The company said its sales for the period were hurt by a five-week strike by truck drivers represented by the Teamsters union.
Giant said sales also were hurt by unusually mild weather. During the same period in the prior year, the region had more severe winter weather, which the company said "added materially" to its sales.
For the fourth quarter, total sales were $1.22 million versus $1.26 million in the prior year's fourth quarter.
